string-array.name: changelog_0_4_1
string-array.item: Holding Backspace now deletes gently at first and then faster. Choose the wait and the speed in Settings > Gestures.
The long-press delay (accents, language picker) is adjustable.
Manage clipboard: edit, pin, delete and clear what was saved. In the keyboard, long-press a clip to edit it.
Diagnostics: if typing still feels slow, turn on “Record response times” in About, type for a minute and copy the report.
Less waiting on the app (capitals are worked out locally) and dictionaries use a third less memory.

string-array.name: changelog_0_4_0
string-array.item: Fixed a crash when holding Space to change language: the chooser is now a panel inside the keyboard.
Accents: hold a key, slide to the accent and lift. The popup no longer stays open.
Personal dictionary editor: add, edit, delete and search your words, per language.
Live preview: the keyboard changes as you pick a theme, an accent color or key tint.
Email and web address fields get @ and .com keys. Names are never autocorrected, and swipe typing stays out of passwords.
About 30,000 words per language now predict the next word, news and web text included, not just chat.
Swipe typing uses the previous word to choose between shapes that fit equally well.
What you just copied shows on the suggestion bar, ready to paste.
Much quicker response while typing: fewer waits on the app, and suggestions are searched off the main thread.

string-array.name: changelog_0_3_0
string-array.item: Live clipboard: what you copy appears as tiles. Tap one to type it, pin it to keep it.
New toolbar next to the suggestions: quick keyboard size and a shortcut to Settings.
The Settings menu now loops: swipe past the last section and you are back at the first.
Settings and the keyboard follow your phone\'s language (English, Spanish, French, German).
Word Flow rebuilt: it looks at the whole dictionary and writes nothing when it is not sure.
60,000 words per language, each language with its own dictionary.
Autocorrect never changes a valid word, and Backspace undoes it.
The 20 official Windows Phone accent colors and a flat clipboard icon.
Fixed: repeated letters (ww, oo) selecting a word, and taps lost when typing with two thumbs.
Back up settings and words to a file you choose, with no storage permission.

string-array.name: changelog_0_2_0
string-array.item: Swipe typing (Word Flow) and swipe left on Backspace to delete whole words.
One-handed mode, light and dark themes, and hardware keyboard support.
Skin tone picker for emoji, and import from the Android personal dictionary.

string-array.name: changelog_0_1_0
string-array.item: First release: flat Metro keys, Shift states, double space for a period and long press for accents.
Offline dictionaries in four languages. No internet permission.

resources.string: Nothing copied yet. What you copy will appear here.
Copied text is kept in memory for one hour; only pinned clips are saved, on this device. Anything the app marks as sensitive is never kept. It is not shown in password fields.
A word has 2 to 40 letters, with no spaces or digits
A development by Ameizin — Andrés Nader · info@ameizin.ec

If typing feels slow, turn this on, type for a minute and copy the report. It records only numbers (how long each key took to answer), never what you type, in memory, until you clear it or the keyboard restarts.
How long you hold a key before its accents (or the language picker on Space) appear.
Holding Backspace deletes one character at a time, gently at first and then faster. A longer wait or a slower speed deletes less by accident.
A clip cannot be empty or longer than 2,000 characters
Tap a clip to edit it. Pinned clips are kept when the keyboard restarts; the rest are forgotten after an hour. In the keyboard, long-press a clip to edit it.
